ns2:course.label: Detection & Estimation Theory
ns2:course.description: (ECE 461) Introduction to detection and estimation theory, with applications to communication, control, and radar systems; decision-theory concepts and optimum-receiver principles; detection of random signals in noise, coherent and noncoherent detection; and parameter estimation, linear and nonlinear estimation, and filtering. Prerequisite: ECE 534 or equivalent or consent of instructor
